Füge einfach dein JSON ein, klicke auf Formatieren und erhalte eine saubere, lesbare Ausgabe. Perfekt zum Debuggen von API-Antworten, Konfigurationsdateien und Datenverarbeitung.

json-formatter.seoFeature4: 100 % clientseitige Verarbeitung — deine Daten verlassen niemals deinen Browser

faqs.q: Is this JSON formatter safe to use?

base64.name: Base64-Kodierer/Dekodierer
base64.description: Text in Base64 kodieren oder Base64 zurück in Text dekodieren
base64.pageDescription: Text in Base64 kodieren oder Base64-Zeichenketten zurück in Klartext dekodieren. Unterstützt UTF-8.
base64.seoContent: Base64 ist ein Binär-zu-Text-Kodierungsverfahren, das Binärdaten als ASCII-Zeichenkette darstellt. Es wird häufig für die Kodierung von Daten in URLs, E-Mails, HTML und APIs verwendet. Dieses Werkzeug unterstützt vollständige UTF-8-Kodierung und -Dekodierung.

faqs.a: Base64 is a binary-to-text encoding scheme that converts binary data into ASCII characters. It's commonly used to transmit data safely over text-based protocols like HTTP and email.

faqs.q: Is Base64 encoding the same as encryption?
faqs.a: No. Base64 is an encoding scheme, not encryption. Anyone can decode Base64 data. It's meant for data transport, not security.
Yes. This tool fully supports UTF-8 encoding and decoding, allowing you to work with international characters and emojis.

howToUseSteps: Enter your plain text in the top field to encode, or Base64 string in the bottom field to decode
Click 'Encode' to convert text to Base64, or 'Decode' to convert Base64 back to text
Copy the result with the copy button
useCases: Encoding images for embedding in HTML/CSS
Transmitting binary data in JSON APIs

url-encoder.name: URL-Kodierer/Dekodierer
url-encoder.description: URL-Komponenten und Abfrageparameter kodieren oder dekodieren
url-encoder.pageDescription: URLs und URI-Komponenten kodieren oder dekodieren. Unterstützt encodeURIComponent und encodeURI.
url-encoder.seoContent: Die URL-Kodierung ersetzt unsichere ASCII-Zeichen durch ein "%" gefolgt von zwei Hexadezimalziffern. Dies ist wichtig für die Übertragung von Sonderzeichen in URLs, Abfrageparametern und Formulardaten. Verwende encodeURIComponent für Abfrageparameter und encodeURI für vollständige URLs.

faqs.a: URL encoding replaces unsafe ASCII characters with a '%' followed by two hex digits. This ensures special characters are safely transmitted in URLs.

faqs.q: What's the difference between encodeURI and encodeURIComponent?
faqs.a: encodeURI encodes a full URL but preserves characters like :, /, ?, &. encodeURIComponent encodes everything including those characters, making it suitable for query parameter values.
Always URL encode when passing user input as query parameters, form data, or any URL component that may contain special characters like spaces, &, =, or #.

howToUseSteps: Enter text in the input field
Choose between URI Component or Full URI encoding mode
Click 'Encode' or 'Decode'
Copy the result
useCases: Handling special characters in API requests

hash-generator.name: Hash-Generator
hash-generator.description: MD5-, SHA-1-, SHA-256-, SHA-512-Hashes aus Text generieren
hash-generator.pageDescription: SHA-1-, SHA-256-, SHA-384-, SHA-512-Hashes aus beliebigem Text generieren. Alles wird in deinem Browser berechnet.
hash-generator.seoContent: Kryptografische Hash-Funktionen erzeugen aus Eingabedaten einen Hashwert fester Größe. Sie werden zur Überprüfung der Datenintegrität, Passwortspeicherung, digitalen Signaturen und mehr verwendet. SHA-256 ist heute der am häufigsten verwendete Algorithmus.

faqs.a: A hash function takes input data and produces a fixed-size string of characters (hash). The same input always produces the same hash, but you cannot reverse a hash back to the original data.

faqs.q: Which hash algorithm should I use?
faqs.a: SHA-256 is recommended for most purposes. SHA-512 offers more security. MD5 and SHA-1 are considered weak for security but are still used for checksums.
Yes. All hash computation happens in your browser using the Web Crypto API. No data is sent to any server.

howToUseSteps: Enter or paste your text in the input field
Click 'Generate Hashes' to compute all hash values
Toggle 'Uppercase' for uppercase hex output
Copy any hash value with the copy button

uuid-generator.name: UUID-Generator
uuid-generator.description: Zufällige UUIDs (v4) in großen Mengen mit einem Klick generieren
uuid-generator.pageDescription: Zufällige UUIDs (v4) in großen Mengen generieren. Unterstützt Großbuchstaben und Formate ohne Bindestriche.
uuid-generator.emptyState: Klicke auf "UUIDs generieren", um zufällige UUIDs zu erstellen
uuid-generator.seoContent: UUID (Universally Unique Identifier) v4 erzeugt zufällige 128-Bit-Kennungen. Mit 122 zufälligen Bits ist die Wahrscheinlichkeit einer Kollision astronomisch gering. UUIDs werden häufig als Datenbank-Primärschlüssel, Sitzungs-Token und Kennungen in verteilten Systemen verwendet.

faqs.a: UUID (Universally Unique Identifier) is a 128-bit number used to uniquely identify information. Version 4 UUIDs are randomly generated, making collision probability astronomically low.
While not mathematically guaranteed, UUID v4 has 2^122 possible values. The probability of generating a duplicate is essentially zero for practical purposes.
Use UUIDs as database primary keys, API resource identifiers, session tokens, or any time you need a unique identifier without a central authority.

howToUseSteps: Set the number of UUIDs to generate (1-20)
Choose options: uppercase, no dashes
Click 'Generate UUIDs'
Click on any UUID to copy, or use 'Copy All'

timestamp-converter.name: Unix-Zeitstempel-Konverter
timestamp-converter.description: Zwischen Unix-Zeitstempeln und lesbaren Datumsangaben umrechnen
timestamp-converter.pageDescription: Unix-Zeitstempel in lesbare Datumsangaben umrechnen und umgekehrt. Erkennt automatisch Sekunden und Millisekunden.
timestamp-converter.seoContent: Ein Unix-Zeitstempel gibt die Anzahl der Sekunden seit dem 1. Januar 1970 (UTC) an. Er wird in der Programmierung, in Datenbanken und APIs weit verbreitet eingesetzt. Dieses Werkzeug erkennt automatisch, ob die Eingabe in Sekunden oder Millisekunden erfolgt.

faqs.a: A Unix timestamp is the number of seconds elapsed since January 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC (the Unix epoch). It's a universal way to represent time in computing.

faqs.q: What's the difference between seconds and milliseconds?
faqs.a: Unix timestamps in seconds are 10 digits (e.g., 1700000000), while milliseconds are 13 digits (e.g., 1700000000000). JavaScript uses milliseconds, most systems use seconds.
Yes. The tool shows both UTC and your local timezone when converting timestamps, so you can see the exact time in both.

howToUseSteps: Enter a Unix timestamp to convert to a human-readable date
Or enter a date string to convert to a Unix timestamp
The tool auto-detects seconds vs milliseconds
View results in UTC, local time, and ISO format
useCases: Converting API timestamps to readable dates
Working with JWT token expiration times

color-converter.pageDescription: Farben zwischen HEX-, RGB- und HSL-Formaten mit Live-Vorschau umwandeln.
color-converter.emptyState: Gib einen Farbwert ein und klicke auf Konvertieren
color-converter.seoContent: HEX-Farben verwenden die Hexadezimalschreibweise (#RRGGBB). RGB nutzt die Kanäle Rot, Grün und Blau (0–255). HSL nutzt Farbton (0–360°), Sättigung (0–100 %) und Helligkeit (0–100 %). Jedes Format hat seine Anwendungsfälle im Webdesign, CSS und Grafikdesign.

faqs.q: What's the difference between HEX, RGB, and HSL?
faqs.a: HEX uses hexadecimal notation. RGB defines colors by red, green, blue values (0-255). HSL uses hue (0-360), saturation, and lightness percentages.

faqs.q: Can I use the color picker?
faqs.a: Yes. Use the built-in color picker to visually select a color, and all format values will update automatically.

howToUseSteps: Enter a color value in any format (HEX, RGB, or HSL)
All other formats update automatically in real-time
Use the color picker for visual selection
Copy any color format with the copy button
useCases: Finding HEX values for CSS styling
Adjusting colors with HSL for hue/saturation tweaks

regex-tester.description: Reguläre Ausdrücke mit Echtzeit-Abgleich und Hervorhebung testen
regex-tester.pageDescription: Reguläre Ausdrücke mit Echtzeit-Abgleich, Hervorhebung und Unterstützung von Erfassungsgruppen testen.
regex-tester.seoContent: Reguläre Ausdrücke (Regex) sind mächtige Muster zum Abgleichen, Suchen und Ersetzen von Text. Sie sind unverzichtbar für die Eingabevalidierung, Textverarbeitung und Datenextraktion. Dieses Werkzeug testet deinen Regex in Echtzeit mit der JavaScript-Regex-Engine.

faqs.q: How do I test my regex?
faqs.a: Enter your regex pattern in the pattern field, add test text below, and the tool will highlight all matches in real-time. Flags like 'g' (global) and 'i' (case-insensitive) are supported.
Yes. All regex processing happens in your browser using JavaScript's built-in RegExp engine. No data is sent anywhere.

Type or paste your test text
View highlighted matches and match details in real-time
useCases: Validating email addresses, URLs, or phone numbers
Extracting data from text (log parsing, web scraping)

Copy the rendered HTML for use in your projects

jwt-decoder.name: JWT-Dekodierer
jwt-decoder.description: JSON Web Tokens dekodieren und untersuchen (Header, Payload, Signatur)
jwt-decoder.pageDescription: JSON Web Tokens dekodieren und untersuchen. Header, Payload und Signatur anzeigen.
jwt-decoder.placeholder: Füge dein JWT-Token hier ein (z.B. eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs...)

Ein JWT besteht aus drei Teilen: Header (Algorithmus & Typ), Payload (Claims & Daten) und Signatur (Verifizierung). JWTs werden häufig in OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect und der API-Authentifizierung verwendet.

faqs.a: JWT (JSON Web Token) is a compact, URL-safe token format used for authentication and information exchange. It contains a header, payload, and signature.

faqs.q: Is it safe to decode JWTs here?
faqs.a: Yes. Decoding happens entirely in your browser. No tokens are sent to any server. Note: decoding only reads the token — it does not verify the signature.

faqs.q: Can this tool verify JWT signatures?
faqs.a: This tool decodes and displays the token contents. Signature verification requires the secret key, which should not be entered into any online tool.

howToUseSteps: Paste your JWT token in the input field
The header, payload, and signature are decoded automatically
View expiration time and other claims
Copy decoded sections as needed

qrcode-generator.description: QR-Codes aus Text, URLs oder beliebigen Daten erstellen

html-entity.name: HTML-Entity-Kodierer
html-entity.description: HTML-Entities und Sonderzeichen kodieren und dekodieren
html-entity.pageDescription: Sonderzeichen in HTML-Entities kodieren oder Entities zurück in Zeichen dekodieren.
html-entity.seoContent: HTML-Entities sind spezielle Codes zur Darstellung reservierter Zeichen in HTML. Zeichen wie <, >, & und \" müssen kodiert werden, damit sie nicht als HTML-Markup interpretiert werden. Dies ist entscheidend zur Vermeidung von XSS-Angriffen und zur Darstellung von Code-Snippets.

faqs.a: HTML entities are special codes that represent characters that have meaning in HTML (like <, >, &) or characters not available on a standard keyboard.

faqs.q: When should I encode HTML entities?
faqs.a: Encode when displaying user input in HTML to prevent XSS attacks, or when you need to display special characters like ©, ™, or mathematical symbols.

faqs.q: Does this handle all special characters?
faqs.a: Yes. This tool handles all standard HTML entities including named entities (&), decimal (&), and hexadecimal (&) formats.

Click 'Decode' to convert HTML entities back to readable text
Copy the result

Displaying code snippets in HTML pages

css-minifier.name: CSS-Minifizierer / Verschönerer
css-minifier.description: CSS-Code für den Produktiveinsatz minifizieren oder für die Lesbarkeit verschönern

css-minifier.seoContent: CSS-Minifizierung entfernt unnötige Zeichen wie Leerzeichen, Kommentare und Semikolons, um die Dateigröße zu reduzieren. Kleinere CSS-Dateien laden schneller und verbessern die Website-Performance und Benutzererfahrung. Verwende den Verschönerungsmodus, um minifiziertes CSS wieder lesbar zu machen.

faqs.a: CSS minification removes whitespace, comments, and unnecessary characters from CSS code to reduce file size and improve page load speed.

faqs.q: Does minification change my CSS behavior?
faqs.a: No. Minification only removes formatting — it doesn't change how your CSS works. The minified version produces identical visual results.

faqs.q: How much file size can I save?
faqs.a: Typically 20-40% reduction depending on the original formatting. Heavily commented files may see even greater savings.

howToUseSteps: Paste your CSS code in the input field
Click 'Minify' to remove whitespace and comments
Or click 'Beautify' to format compressed CSS for readability
Copy the result for your project

number-base.description: Zahlen zwischen Binär, Oktal, Dezimal und Hexadezimal umrechnen
number-base.pageDescription: Zahlen sofort zwischen Dezimal, Binär, Oktal und Hexadezimal umrechnen.

faqs.a: Number bases (or radixes) are systems for representing numbers. Common bases: binary (base 2), octal (base 8), decimal (base 10), and hexadecimal (base 16).
Hexadecimal is compact and maps neatly to binary — each hex digit represents exactly 4 binary bits. It's widely used for colors, memory addresses, and byte values.
Binary (base 2) is the fundamental language of computers. Understanding binary helps with bitwise operations, networking (IP addresses), and low-level programming.

This tool uses a line-by-line comparison algorithm that identifies added, removed, and unchanged lines between the two texts.
Yes. The diff tool works with any text including source code, configuration files, documentation, or plain text.

faqs.q: What do the special characters mean?
faqs.a: * means any value, / means step (*/5 = every 5), , means list (1,3,5), - means range (1-5), and specific numbers mean exact values.

faqs.q: Can I see when my cron job will run next?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your cron expression and the tool will show the next scheduled execution times, plus a human-readable description.

Check the next scheduled run times

http-status.name: HTTP-Statuscode-Referenz
http-status.seoContent: HTTP status codes are three-digit numbers returned by servers to indicate the result of a client request. They are grouped into five classes: 1xx (informational), 2xx (success), 3xx (redirection), 4xx (client errors), and 5xx (server errors). Understanding these codes is essential for API development, debugging network issues, and building robust web applications. This reference tool lets you quickly look up any status code, understand its meaning, and learn when to use it in your own APIs. It covers all standard codes defined in RFC 7231 and common extensions.

faqs.q: What is the difference between 401 and 403?
faqs.a: 401 Unauthorized means the client has not provided valid authentication credentials. 403 Forbidden means the client is authenticated but does not have permission to access the resource.

faqs.q: When should I use 200 vs 201 vs 204?
faqs.a: Use 200 OK for successful GET requests, 201 Created when a new resource is created (POST), and 204 No Content for successful requests with no response body (DELETE).

faqs.q: What does a 502 Bad Gateway error mean?
faqs.a: 502 means the server acting as a gateway received an invalid response from an upstream server. It usually indicates a problem with the backend service, not the client.

howToUseSteps: Browse the status codes by category (1xx through 5xx)
Click on any code to see its detailed description
Use the search box to find a specific code quickly
Review the use cases to understand when to return each code
useCases: Debugging HTTP errors in web applications

Getting the MIME type wrong can cause browsers to download files instead of displaying them, or break file uploads. This tool lets you look up the correct MIME type for any file extension, or find which extensions correspond to a given content type. It includes hundreds of MIME types covering images, audio, video, documents, fonts, and application-specific formats.

faqs.a: A MIME type is a string like 'text/html' or 'image/png' that tells the browser or client how to interpret and display a file. It consists of a type and subtype separated by a slash.

faqs.q: How do I find the MIME type for a file extension?
faqs.a: Type the file extension (e.g., .pdf, .webp) into the search box. The tool will show the corresponding MIME type and category.

faqs.q: What MIME type should I use for JSON?

howToUseSteps: Enter a file extension (e.g., .svg) or MIME type (e.g., image/svg+xml)

escape-unescape.seoContent: Character escaping converts special characters into safe representations to prevent injection attacks and parsing errors. HTML escaping converts characters like < > & into entities (< > &). JavaScript escaping handles quotes and backslashes in strings. JSON escaping ensures strings are valid within JSON documents. This tool supports all three escaping modes and their reverse operations. It is essential for security-conscious developers who need to sanitize user input, build safe HTML output, or debug encoded strings in logs and API responses.

faqs.q: What is the difference between HTML and JavaScript escaping?
faqs.a: HTML escaping converts < > & " to HTML entities for safe display in web pages. JavaScript escaping adds backslashes before quotes, newlines, and special characters for safe use in JS strings.

faqs.q: Why do I need to escape strings?
faqs.a: Unescaped strings can cause XSS (cross-site scripting) attacks in HTML, syntax errors in JavaScript, or invalid JSON. Escaping ensures special characters are treated as data, not code.

faqs.q: Can I unescape encoded strings back to plain text?
faqs.a: Yes. Switch to Unescape mode and paste the encoded string. The tool will convert escape sequences back to their original characters.

ip-calculator.name: IP-Subnetz-Rechner
ip-calculator.seoContent: IP subnetting divides a network into smaller subnetworks to improve performance and security. Understanding subnets is critical for network administrators, DevOps engineers, and anyone configuring cloud infrastructure. This calculator takes an IP address with a CIDR prefix (e.g., 192.168.1.0/24) and instantly computes the subnet mask, network address, broadcast address, first and last usable host, and total number of hosts. It supports both IPv4 addresses and various CIDR notations from /8 to /30. All calculations are done locally in your browser.

faqs.a: CIDR (Classless Inter-Domain Routing) notation like /24 indicates how many bits are used for the network portion of an IP address. /24 means 24 network bits and 8 host bits, allowing 254 usable hosts.

faqs.q: How do I calculate the number of hosts in a subnet?
faqs.a: The formula is 2^(32-prefix) - 2 for IPv4. The subtraction accounts for the network address and broadcast address. A /24 subnet has 2^8 - 2 = 254 usable hosts.

faqs.q: What is the difference between network and broadcast address?
faqs.a: The network address is the first address in a subnet (all host bits 0) and identifies the subnet. The broadcast address is the last (all host bits 1) and sends packets to all hosts in the subnet.

hmac-generator.name: HMAC-Generator
hmac-generator.pageDescription: Generiere HMAC-Signaturen mit SHA-256 oder SHA-1.
hmac-generator.seoContent: HMAC (Hash-based Message Authentication Code) combines a cryptographic hash function with a secret key to verify both data integrity and authenticity. Unlike simple hashing, HMAC requires the secret key to generate and verify signatures, making it resistant to tampering. HMAC-SHA256 is the most commonly used variant and is required by many APIs and webhook systems (Stripe, GitHub, Shopify). This tool generates HMAC signatures using SHA-1, SHA-256, or SHA-512 algorithms. Enter your message and secret key, and get the signature in hexadecimal or Base64 format. All computation happens locally.

faqs.q: What is the difference between HMAC and a regular hash?
faqs.a: A regular hash (like SHA-256) only takes a message as input. HMAC also requires a secret key, so only parties who know the key can generate or verify the signature. This prevents tampering.

faqs.q: Which HMAC algorithm should I use?
faqs.a: HMAC-SHA256 is the most common and recommended choice. It offers strong security and is required by most modern APIs. Use SHA-1 only for legacy compatibility.

faqs.q: How do I verify a webhook signature with HMAC?
faqs.a: Compute the HMAC of the webhook payload using your secret key, then compare it to the signature in the webhook header. If they match, the webhook is authentic and untampered.

This tool decodes PEM-formatted certificates and displays all X.509 fields: subject, issuer, validity dates, serial number, signature algorithm, public key details, and extensions like Subject Alternative Names (SANs). It is essential for DevOps engineers managing SSL certificates, debugging TLS handshake failures, and verifying certificate chains.

faqs.q: What information can I see from a PEM certificate?
faqs.a: You can see the subject (domain name), issuer (CA), validity dates, serial number, signature algorithm, public key type and size, and extensions like SANs and key usage.

faqs.q: Is it safe to paste my certificate here?
faqs.a: Yes. All decoding happens locally in your browser. Your certificate data is never sent to any server. Note: never paste private keys in any online tool.

faqs.q: What is the difference between PEM and DER format?
faqs.a: PEM is Base64-encoded text with header/footer lines, readable in any text editor. DER is the raw binary format. This tool only handles PEM format.
